definitions.explanation: a pen or marker that uses water-soluble ink, as opposed to oil-based or permanent markers

examples.japanese: ⟦ホワイトボード→ホワイトボード：23126_howaitoboodo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{水性|すいせい}ペン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Use a water-based pen for the whiteboard.

examples.japanese: {水性|すいせい}ペン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{汚|よご}れ→汚れ：03186_yogore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{落|お}ち→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Water-based pen stains are easy to wash out with water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{洗|あら}える→洗う：00827_arau⟧{水性|すいせい}ペン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たせる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I make sure to give the children water-based pens so stains can be washed out of their clothes.

notes:
Combines {水性|すいせい} (water-based) and ⟦ペン→ペン：02960_pen⟧ (pen). A practical stationery term commonly encountered when shopping for office supplies in Japan. Water-based pens are preferred for children and whiteboards because they wash out easily.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水性|すいせい}ペン⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write with a water-based pen
- {水性|すいせい}ペン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦インク→インク：00120_inku⟧: water-based pen ink
- {水性|すいせい}ペンセット: water-based pen set

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油性|ゆせい}ペン→油性ペン：19744_yuseipen⟧: oil-based pen — permanent marker, does not wash out easily
- ⟦マーカー→マーカー：21828_maakaa⟧: marker — general term for felt-tip markers
- ⟦サインペン→サインペン：24225_sainpen⟧: felt-tip pen — a brand-name-derived generic term for fine markers
- ⟦{蛍光|けいこう}ペン→蛍光ペン：07069_keikoupen⟧: highlighter pen
